input.prompt: Compute the bulk modulus of Magnesium by applying small finite deformations and calculating the full elastic constant tensor, followed by the Voigt averaging method. Simulate a face centered cubic lattice structure for Magnesium using LAMMPS with a lattice constant of 3.21 angstrom. The simulation should use metal units, define a 5 x 5 x 5 simulation box, and set periodic boundary conditions to True in all directions. Use the Embedded Atom Method (EAM) potential for Magnesium. First, relax the simulation box to zero pressure using the box/relax fix and perform energy minimization with a force tolerance of 1e-10, energy tolerance of 0.0, maximum iterations of 100, and maximum evaluations of 1000. Save the relaxed structure. Then, apply small symmetric deformations in each of the six independent strain directions, and after each deformation, perform energy minimization to relax the atomic positions using the same minimization parameters. From the stress response of each deformation, compute the full elastic constant tensor, and calculate the bulk modulus using the Voigt average formula. Report the final value of the bulk modulus in GPa.
